letter.content: I have been a faithful smoker of your new cigarete, Salem Lights, previous smoker of Salem regular. I bought it because of the lower tar+ nicotine content. But when I opened a new pack of Lights, I lit up one, and the draw was very light. I noticed the filter tip was fostered unsecurely, letting air through the passage: 502475532. Thinking nothing of this, I opened another one, but to my dismay, the same thing happened. I contacted your department, for there was a third one in the pack.
